name: Cross-sectional funding dispersion — short leg (high-funding perps, carry received on short)
rationale: Mirror of the long-low-funding leg (xsec-funding-dispersion-long-leg.json). Among the 20-asset OKX USDT-M perp universe, perpetuals with the HIGHEST cross-sectional funding rank are the 'most crowded longs' — longs in these perps pay the most carry. A SHORT in a high-funding perp RECEIVES that carry (positive funding is collected by the short side). The premium has two exit paths: (1) funding normalises back to mid-universe levels (momentum mean-reversion), or (2) the crowded long unwinds abruptly (directional downside also profits the short). xsec_funding_rank > rank_floor (top quartile) is the entry condition. Paired with the long-low-funding leg, the two legs form a dollar-neutral, market-beta-cancelled book; the combined edge is the cross-sectional funding dispersion premium. Leverage: 2:1 gross (FR-legal, OKX EU). Funding_feature accrues positive carry to P&L every bar on the short (positive funding received). Vol ceiling guards against violent short-squeezes that would overwhelm the carry income. No magic numbers — all thresholds in param_space.
catalyst: Cross-sectional funding dispersion: high-funding perps are over-crowded relative to peers; short receives carry and benefits from mean-reversion of crowding.
